settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure Lyrico and review local application behavior.
settings.descriptionEffective: Settings here directly control online matching, lyric writing and library behavior.
settings.languageHint: System follows the Windows display language and falls back to English.
settings.startupDescription: Lyrico loads lightweight song summaries from SQLite. Audio files are scanned only when you add or explicitly rescan a folder.
settings.persistenceValue: Loading the active SQLite database path...
settings.artworkValue: Prefetched near the viewport and loaded in shared batches
settings.searchPageSizeHint: Each enabled plugin returns up to this many results. Range: 5–50.
settings.enabledPluginsHint: {{count}} enabled plugins are searched together by default.
settings.defaultLyricFormatHint: Used when previewing and applying lyrics returned by plugins.
settings.lyricsConversionModeHint: Convert lyric text after parsing, using the same processing order as mobile.
settings.includeTranslationHint: Write the translated track when the plugin provides one.
settings.onlyTranslationHint: Replace the original line with its translation when a translation exists.
settings.includeRomanizationHint: Write the romanized track when the plugin provides one.
settings.removeEmptyLyricLinesHint: Clean empty lines after plugin lyrics are encoded.
settings.themeModeHint: Choose between light, dark, or follow your system setting.

artistSplit.title: Artist splitting
artistSplit.artistSeparatorHint: Used to join multiple ARTIST values while scanning tags. Rescan folders after changing it.
artistSplit.enabledHint: List songs with multiple artists under each artist separately.
artistSplit.liveDescription: Splitting and no-split rules regroup the desktop artist view immediately; no artist-index rebuild is required.
artistSplit.builtinSeparatorsHint: Slash, semicolon and comma variants follow the mobile defaults. Ampersand and featuring markers are optional.
artistSplit.customSeparatorsHint: Type a separator and press Enter. Whitespace is preserved when it is part of the separator.
artistSplit.customSeparatorsPlaceholder: Add separators such as + or with
artistSplit.noSplitHint: Checked names are protected even when they contain an enabled separator.
artistSplit.customNoSplitHint: Type a complete artist name and press Enter.
artistSplit.customNoSplitPlaceholder: Add artist names that must stay intact
